text: The nightly export to the accounts system failed again last night. Can you find out why and fix it?
I'll read last night's run log first, then the export code.

Found it. The export failed because the accounts API now rejects any batch over 500 rows, and last night's batch had 1,240. I've changed `lib/export/batch.js` to split batches at 500 and added a test; all 212 tests pass. The change is in PR #418 (https://github.com/example/app/pull/418).

| Night | Rows | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Mon | 310 | ok |
| Tue | 480 | ok |
| Wed | 1,240 | failed |

Two things need deciding:

1. **Re-run last night's export now, or wait for tonight's run?** Re-running now sends Wednesday's 1,240 rows today, but the accounts team is in month-end close and asked not to receive data between 9 and 5. Waiting means Wednesday's rows arrive with Thursday's, about 14 hours late.
2. **Merge the PR myself, or wait for a review?** It is a six-line change with a test.

One caveat: I could not find the API's limit documented anywhere, so 500 comes from the error message. If the real limit is lower the export will fail again tonight; I added a log line so we would see why.
